bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
target='theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV'
units=()
while IFS= read -r unit; do
  [ -n "$unit" ] || continue
  body="$(systemctl --user cat "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  printf '%s' "$body" | grep -Fqi "$target" && units+=("$unit")
done < <(systemctl --user list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
[ "${#units[@]}" -eq 1 ] || exit 70
unit="${units[0]}"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$unit" || exit 71
pid="$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p MainPID --value)"
[ "$pid" -gt 0 ] || exit 72
log="$(journalctl --user -u "$unit" --since '2026-11-15 00:00:00' -n 150 --no-pager -o cat 2>/dev/null || true)"
if printf '%s' "$log" | grep -Eiq 'all (videos|messages) (downloaded|completed)|collection complete|archive complete'; then exit 73; fi
if printf '%s' "$log" | grep -Eiq 'traceback|permission denied|no space left|mount.*(lost|unavailable)|failed to save'; then exit 74; fi
if printf '%s' "$log" | grep -Eiq 'download|video|message|progress'; then exit 75; fi
exit 76
